records.title: SSUMamba: Spatial-Spectral Selective State Space Model for Hyperspectral Image Denoising
records.abstractLevel: official arXiv abstract for formal related preprint
records.abstractSummary: SSUMamba uses spatial–spectral continuous scans in six row/column/band orders, bidirectional state-space modeling for long-range dependencies, and 3D convolutions for local features; abstract reports lower memory use than Transformer methods.

records.title: Spectral–Spatial Large Kernel Attention Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
records.abstractLevel: public abstract mirror with IEEE metadata
records.abstractSummary: SSLKA uses two cooperative spectral–spatial attention blocks with large kernels; spectral and spatial branches generate attention maps and fuse features for local context, long-range dependency and channel adaptivity.
